store.summary: Share the aircraft you receive with Flightradar24, Plane Finder and AirNav
store.description:
ZeroAirFeeder turns the CardputerZero into an ADS-B feeder for Flightradar24, Plane Finder and AirNav RadarBox. Plug an RTL-SDR dongle with a 1090 MHz antenna into the USB-A port, fit the Cap LoRa-1262 with GPS, connect to Wi-Fi and start feeding.

- Enter your FR24 sharing key, or get a new one from the app through Flightradar24's own signup.
- Plane Finder (with your share code) and AirNav RadarBox (key received automatically) can be turned on or off in SETUP; on the KEYS page every feeder's key works the same way: type the one you have, or get a new one (FR24 signup, Plane Finder QR code, AirNav automatic); all the services feed from the same receiver.
- Antenna position and altitude from the GPS of the M5Stack Cap LoRa-1262.
- Downloads each service's official program by itself (fr24feed, pfclient, rbfeeder), checked against its maker's signature or a pinned checksum. No root, no sudo.
- Feeds only while the app is open and you started it: nothing runs in the background.
- FEED page: one row per feeder with its own state and numbers, coloured at a glance, then receiver and GPS.
- Receiver gain and PPM, log, light and dark theme. English and Italian.

The package bundles readsb (GPL-3.0). fr24feed, pfclient and rbfeeder are the software of Flightradar24, Plane Finder and AirNav Systems, downloaded from them under their own terms.
